description: NVD CPE fallback with real range evaluation, and the two confidence bands it can reach. pyyaml is a PyPI package, so the bridge guesses vendor == product and that identity claim holds -> RANGE. openssl arrives as pkg:generic with no vendor convention to lean on, so only the product-only candidate applies -> HEURISTIC. Both derive an approximate fix from versionEndExcluding, flagged by fixSource = CPE_RANGE.
